verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a way to opt out of GrowthBook's own telemetry or usage tracking, such as an environment variable or setting that disables anonymous usage reporting in self-hosted or cloud deployments. The related items do not count toward this story: SDK attribute values are 'never sent to GrowthBook', the third-party tracking plugin is optional, and self-hosting is available. These are adjacent privacy features, not a telemetry opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
